payload.title: Concepts Wiki pages and concept names are localized just in time
payload.description:
As a reader of a localized site, I want wiki pages and concept names in my language, so the Concepts Wiki works the same way as the articles.

Design (Ryan's decision 12): wiki pages are wiki_page Items, localized by the same JIT procedure once the primary page is published (the primary's review stamp remains the gate). Concepts get localized names and aliases on the shared concept, so a Spanish hashtag or link resolves to the same concept. Plan: docs/plans/multilingual-publishing.md (PR #1450), revised 2026-11-12 with Ryan's decisions.

Feature: Localized wiki

Scenario: A published wiki page gets its Spanish version
  Given Spanish is enabled and a wiki page is published with its review stamp
  When the procedure runs
  Then the Spanish wiki page is published at its Spanish address with the translation label

Scenario: A Spanish concept name resolves to the shared concept
  Given a concept with a Spanish name
  When a Spanish page links that name
  Then the link opens the Spanish page of the same concept
